recipe.visualDefinition: A minimalist 1970s-style album cover featuring a large field of olive-drab green, a small rectangular photographic inset of a couple in a warm, intimate embrace, and two distinct styles of vintage typography centered within a thin black frame.
coreVisualRelationships: Small photographic window contrasted against a vast monochromatic background
Intricate, swash-heavy display type balanced by a heavy, rounded sans-serif
Thin geometric framing containing all central elements within the larger square canvas
coreInvariants: Rectangular photo inset located in the upper third
Large-scale swash lettering in the lower half of the frame

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centralized vertical stack; photo is small (approx 15% height), main title is large (approx 30% height).
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The intricate white swash lettering in the center-bottom of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top rounded text, drops to the intimate photo, and settles on the large flowing script below.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive olive-green margins outside the thin black rectangular border.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm browns and skin tones (photo inset)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low-saturation background with high-value, high-contrast typography.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: High-contrast serif with extreme swashes and heavy rounded sans-serif
letterConstructionRules: Main title uses thin strokes with thick vertical stems and elongated, curling swashes on terminals
Secondary title uses ultra-bold, tightly spaced, rounded geometric forms
Overlapping characters in the main title to create a woven effect
characterSpecificRedesigns: M and M characters feature deep, circular swashes that extend into the negative space
Letters like 'y' and 'd' have tails that loop back toward the center
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of a fluid, ornate serif with a rigid, heavy geometric sans.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the 70s ornate serif feel with similar terminal loops.
Matches the rounded, thick geometric upper text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A solid matte olive-drab green background. In the center, a thin black rectangular hairline frame. Inside the top third of the frame, a small horizontal rectangular photograph of a couple in a warm, low-light intimate embrace with a vintage film grain.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of large, interlocking off-white swash-serif text in the bottom half of the frame. Add one line of bold, rounded, uppercase sans-serif text centered above the photo.

verificationChecks: Is the background a muted olive green?
Are the swashes on the main text interlocking and ornate?
Is the photo inset small and centered?
Is there a thin black frame containing the elements?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features in the photo
postGenerationChecks: Check that the swashes do not obscure legibility entirely.
Ensure the thin black border is perfectly centered.
Verify the photo inset has a vintage, warm-toned aesthetic.
Confirm the olive green is not too vibrant or neon.
recipe.reuseFormula: Olive green field + thin hairline frame + small intimate photo window + heavy swash-serif display type.
